definitions.full_domain_cut: Minimum number of declared failure domains over all modeled layers that reduces the maximum root-disjoint surviving witness packing below three.
definitions.layer_cut: Same computation restricted to a specified layer, with failures in other layers not invoked.

independence: Declared source identity and operational failure-domain independence are separate requirements.
limitations: Synthetic failure model, not measured site reliability
No proof that declared roots/providers/regions are genuinely independent
No failure probabilities, correlated likelihoods, or temporal persistence
Brute force exact domain search; not suitable for unbounded networks
next: H052 failure domain allocation and adversarial placement with cost constraints
